component.name: ProbeRowItem
component.script:
sub init() m.name = "?" end sub
sub onContent() m.name = m.top.itemContent.title m.top.findNode("title").text = m.name end sub
function fmt(v as float) as string return Str(Int(v * 1000 + 0.5) / 1000).trim() end function
sub logField(field as string, value as string) m.top.getScene().callFunc("itemLog", m.name + "." + field + "=" + value) end sub
sub onFocusPercent() logField("focusPercent", fmt(m.top.focusPercent)) end sub
sub onRowFocusPercent() ' Only the first column, so a row's ramp shows once rather than per item. if m.name.instr("I0") > 0 then logField("rowFocusPercent", fmt(m.top.rowFocusPercent)) end sub
sub onRowHeightPercent() if m.name.instr("I0") > 0 then logField("rowHeightPercent", fmt(m.top.rowHeightPercent)) end sub
sub onHasFocus() v = "false" if m.top.itemHasFocus then v = "true" logField("itemHasFocus", v) end sub
sub onRowHasFocus() v = "false" if m.top.rowHasFocus then v = "true" if m.name.instr("I0") > 0 then logField("rowHasFocus", v) end sub
